# Hazke

A wireframe 3D space trading and combat game. Fly between sixteen star systems, trade 17 goods, take jobs from planets and fight pirates. Hazke started on the M5Stack Cardputer, and this version uses the same galaxy, markets and ships.

## How to play

- Fly into a planet to land. On a planet you can trade at the market, take a job and buy equipment.
- Fly into a jump gate to open the galactic chart, then pick a linked system and jump. A jump costs 10 credits per light year.
- Pirates attack on sight. Lock on, fire your lasers and missiles, and collect the bounty.
- Your standing with four factions changes prices, and a faction's patrols attack you if it drops too low.
- The game saves each time you land and each time you take off.

## Controls

- Up and Down pitch the ship, and Left and Right roll it.
- Hold OK to fire the laser. Double-click OK to fire a missile.
- Tap BACK to change speed. Hold BACK for the flight menu.
- In the flight menu, AUTODOCK flies you to the marked planet and lands, ATTACK NEAREST locks onto the closest pirate, and TARGET picks what to fly to.
- Press any direction to take the controls back from the autopilot.
